verdict.summary: The synchronous cfg/on propagation and owned-vote unwind are supported by extracted-C host evidence. Off restoration failure leaves IS_SENSOR_ICLK_ON set after this caller's selected vote is absent; a repeated off can consume a shared vote. The runtime suspend wrapper reports success for that error and the next resume skips clock setup.
verdict.scope: Pinned source review and deterministic extracted-C shims only; no kernel, provider, physical-clock, or device acceptance.

checks.name: actual extracted baseline and patched C paths
checks.patched_result: PASS: extracted sensor clock callbacks propagate and unwind owned votes
coverage: all eight cfg enable positions: CSIS0-6 and DMA
reverse cfg unwind and first-error preservation

checks.name: temporary extracted-C shared-vote retry negative control
checks.output_marker: NEGATIVE_CONTROL: retry consumed the remaining shared selected-clock reference
checks.scenario: Successful on; DMA disable lookup error after selected-gate release; selected-gate restoration enable error; call actual extracted is_sensor_iclk_off again.
checks.observed_transition: The first off leaves ON set and only the modeled shared selected-clock reference. The retry succeeds while decrementing that reference to zero.

findings.title: Off retry can release a selected-clock vote this sensor no longer owns
findings.evidence: If DMA disable returns lookup error after selected disable succeeds and selected restoration enable then fails, the callback returns error while the caller retains IS_SENSOR_ICLK_ON. A second off retries selected disable with no per-caller selected vote; extracted-C negative control shows the remaining shared reference drops from one to zero.
findings.limitation: The fake reference counter proves the source-level retry sequence, not a live device or provider transition.

findings.title: Runtime PM masks off failure and resume skips reconciliation
findings.evidence: Runtime suspend only warns when is_sensor_iclk_off() fails and returns zero. With the ON bit retained, the next resume enters is_sensor_iclk_on(), sees the bit, and returns success without calling cfg/on.
findings.execution_status: Source-traced; runtime PM wrapper itself was not extracted or executed in the host harness.

findings.title: Negative disable injection is not provider-disable evidence
findings.evidence: is_disable() returns -EINVAL only when clock lookup is absent before clk_disable_unprepare(); that API is void and the helper otherwise returns zero.
findings.consequence: No test result here proves a provider error was reported, a physical gate stayed on/off, or a real hardware partial-off failure occurred.

findings.title: Synchronous cfg/on propagation and reverse cleanup match the pinned caller sequence
findings.evidence: Extracted C passes injected cfg acquisition failures for CSIS0-6 and DMA, selected-gate enable failures for channels 0-6, setup-gate disable failures for channels 0-6, invalid channel 7 no-touch checks, and first-error/reverse-order assertions at C -O0 and -O2.
